evals.prompt: Refresh this repo and clean up merged branches.
evals.expected_output: The agent invokes the bundled refresh_repo.sh helper, detects master from origin/HEAD, fast-forwards it, deletes a cleanly merged local branch with git branch -d, and reports every action.
expectations: The agent invokes scripts/refresh_repo.sh instead of hand-running the default git sequence.
The repository ends on the default branch named master.
The default branch contains the upstream commit that was fetched by fast-forward.
The cleanly merged local branch is deleted.
The response reports fetch/prune, detected default branch, switch, fast-forward, and deleted branch details.

evals.prompt: Get me back to a clean current main.
evals.expected_output: The default run deletes only cleanly merged local branches and leaves an upstream-gone branch with a unique unpushed commit untouched while offering gated cleanup.
expectations: The agent invokes scripts/refresh_repo.sh with no arguments for the default run.
The merged branch is gone after the run.
The upstream-gone branch with a unique commit still exists after the run.
The response asks a follow-up question before any upstream-gone pruning.
The response lists the unique commit before offering force-delete cleanup.

evals.prompt: Refresh the repo, then prune the gone branch if it is safe.
evals.expected_output: After the user opts in, the gated upstream-gone pruning path deletes a gone branch with no unique commits via git branch -d and leaves force-delete candidates untouched.
expectations: The default run happens before the gated pruning action.
The agent invokes scripts/refresh_repo.sh --prune-gone only after the opt-in portion of the prompt.
The upstream-gone branch with no commits absent from main is deleted.
The upstream-gone branch with a unique commit is reported and still exists.
No force-delete occurs during the prune-gone action.

evals.expected_output: A dirty worktree that blocks switching is reported, and the agent leaves the current branch and uncommitted changes untouched.
expectations: The agent invokes scripts/refresh_repo.sh.
The current branch remains unchanged.
The uncommitted file content remains unchanged.
The response reports the dirty worktree and skipped switch or fast-forward steps.
The agent does not stash, reset, checkout-discard, or otherwise hide the uncommitted change.
